rationale: The workflow is a single-job, single-step tweet action triggered by release publication and manual dispatch. It performs no dependency installation, no checkout, no build, no test execution, and has no matrix. The applicable cache patterns (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE, P-LIT-ENV-CACHE, P-LIT-BAZEL-*) require dependency installation or a build system that this workflow does not have. Matrix-based patterns (P-LIT-FAIL-FAST, P-LIT-FAILED-JOB-FIRST) require multiple jobs. Schedule-based patterns (P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE, P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE) require a schedule trigger. Test selection/prioritization patterns require tests. Change filtering is not meaningful for release-dispatch triggers. No supported optimization fits while preserving the intended behavior, so no change is warranted.
